name: io.github.knowledgepa3/gia-mcp-server
title: GIA — Governed Intelligence Architecture
description: Runtime governance layer for AI agents: MAI decision classification, human-in-the-loop gates, hash-chained forensic audit, governed context authority, and compliance mapping (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001, SOC 2, CMMC). Model-agnostic — runs embedded, no remote service required.

environment_variables.name: DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for a persistent forensic audit trail (optional — the governance engine runs in-memory without it)

environment_variables.name: GIA_TOOL_VISIBILITY
environment_variables.description: Tool visibility tier: public | tenant | operator (optional — local stdio defaults to operator)

environment_variables.name: GIA_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: API key for the hosted GIA platform (optional — only needed when connecting to gia.aceadvising.com instead of running embedded)

headers.description: Bearer <GIA_API_KEY> — the endpoint accepts an Authorization bearer token or a GIA_API_KEY query parameter. It does NOT accept x-api-key.
headers.name: Authorization
